verdict.summary: The change correctly centralizes the merge-ref graded-base derivation and exact git argv in one pure, fail-closed owner, while preserving each consumer's existing verdict policy. Both consumers delegate through the shared module, refuse malformed or non-two-parent output before using any SHA, and retain their independent head/live-tip checks. The new tests independently pin argv, parent orientation, SHA shape, refusal behavior, consumer delegation, and restoration of test sentinels; the module is also enrolled in the protected self-test manifest. I found no correctness, security, or material test-validity defect in the diff.
